name: Yasho Industries Ltd
tagline: NSE: YASHO | EXCLUDED - already upper-midcap (~Rs 5,083 Cr), stretched valuation
summary: Specialty chemicals across food antioxidants, aroma chemicals, rubber chemicals, lubricant additives (148 products, 5 verticals). Source sheet noted it 'already turned into a multi-bagger.'
fundamentals_table: Profit +890.3% YoY to Rs 36.05 Cr (off a low base); stock hit a 52-week high
fundamentals_narrative: The +890% profit growth headline is real but almost certainly reflects a low prior-year base rather than a durable new run-rate - the P/E of 97x against an ROE under 8% is a very demanding combination that the current quarter alone doesn't yet justify. Already an upper-midcap, further limiting the size-based case.
technical_read: Confirmed strong momentum - stock hit a fresh 52-week high following the Q1 results.
sentiment_summary: Source sheet's own framing ('already turned into a multi-bagger') suggests the community views this as a completed re-rating story, consistent with this research.
bse_notes: Not researched in depth given the size and valuation-stretch combination.
bull_case: Genuine, diversified specialty-chemicals platform across 5 verticals
Explosive latest-quarter profit growth and confirmed price momentum
bear_case: Already upper-midcap (Rs 5,083 Cr) - a 10x is a very high bar from here
P/E of 97x against ROE under 8% is a stretched valuation combination
Profit surge likely reflects a low comparison base, not a proven new trend
market_cap_tier: Upper-midcap (~Rs 5,083 Cr) - excluded on combined size + valuation-stretch grounds.
verdict_headline: EXCLUDED - already re-rated, size and valuation both argue against a further 10x
verdict_reasoning: Market cap headroom is limited for a genuine 10x
Valuation (P/E 97x vs ROE <8%) is priced for a level of quality not yet demonstrated over multiple quarters
Source sheet itself frames this as an already-completed multi-bagger, not a forward setup
